gates.description: Each finding must include severity, affected component, and PoC
Each finding must include specific remediation recommendation
Each finding must have a CVSS score
Findings must be mapped to OWASP or CWE categories
Non-technical executive summary must be present

anti_patterns.description: Running automated tools and reporting the output without verifying findings
Deleting data, crashing production systems, or exfiltrating real user data
Reporting 200 findings with no context or prioritization — team fixes nothing
Verbal permission is not authorization — must have written, signed scope
Only testing the web app and ignoring API, mobile, infrastructure, and human elements

escalation_triggers: Critical vulnerability discovered that is actively exploitable from the internet
Evidence of prior compromise (existing backdoors, unexplained accounts)
Vulnerability in a third-party component affecting multiple systems
Finding that requires immediate action before the report is finalized
Legal or compliance implication of a finding (data breach notification requirements)

input_requirements.description: Written scope definition and rules of engagement

output_certifications: Each finding has severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low) and CVSS score
Each finding includes steps to reproduce and specific remediation
Findings mapped to OWASP or CWE categories
Executive summary present for non-technical stakeholders
Attack narratives show kill chains combining multiple vulnerabilities
